SET SERVEROUTPUT ON
SET DEFINE OFF
SET AUTOCOMMIT OFF
SET LINESIZE 180
SET PAGESIZE 100
SET LONG 20000
SET LONGCHUNKSIZE 20000
SELECT product, version, version_full FROM product_component_version;

SELECT * FROM pgd_person ORDER BY person_id;

SELECT * FROM pgd_knows ORDER BY edge_id;

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgd_rel_graph
  VERTEX TABLES (
    pgd_person AS people KEY (person_id)
      LABEL person PROPERTIES (person_id, person_name AS name, city)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    pgd_knows AS links KEY (edge_id)
      SOURCE KEY (src_id) REFERENCES people (person_id)
      DESTINATION KEY (dst_id) REFERENCES people (person_id)
      LABEL knows PROPERTIES (edge_id, since_year)
  )
  OPTIONS (ENFORCED MODE);

SELECT neighbor, since_year
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (pgd_rel_graph
  MATCH (a IS person)-[e IS knows]->(b IS person)
  WHERE a.person_id = 1
  COLUMNS (b.name AS neighbor, e.since_year AS since_year)
)
ORDER BY neighbor;

SELECT start_name, via_name, target_name
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (pgd_rel_graph
  MATCH (a IS person)-[e1 IS knows]->(b IS person)
                     -[e2 IS knows]->(c IS person)
  WHERE a.person_id = 1
  COLUMNS (a.name AS start_name, b.name AS via_name,
           c.name AS target_name)
)
ORDER BY via_name, target_name;

SELECT a.person_name AS start_name, b.person_name AS via_name,
       c.person_name AS target_name
FROM pgd_person a
JOIN pgd_knows e1 ON e1.src_id = a.person_id
JOIN pgd_person b ON b.person_id = e1.dst_id
JOIN pgd_knows e2 ON e2.src_id = b.person_id
JOIN pgd_person c ON c.person_id = e2.dst_id
WHERE a.person_id = 1
ORDER BY via_name, target_name;

SELECT target_name, COUNT(*) AS route_count
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (pgd_rel_graph
  MATCH (a IS person)-[e1 IS knows]->(b IS person)-[e2 IS knows]->(c IS person)
  WHERE a.person_id = 1
  COLUMNS (c.name AS target_name)
)
GROUP BY target_name
ORDER BY target_name;

SELECT start_name, via_name, third_name
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (pgd_rel_graph
  MATCH (a IS person)-[e1 IS knows]->(b IS person)
                     -[e2 IS knows]->(c IS person)-[e3 IS knows]->(a)
  WHERE a.person_id = 1 AND b.person_id <> a.person_id
        AND c.person_id <> a.person_id AND b.person_id <> c.person_id
  COLUMNS (a.name AS start_name, b.name AS via_name, c.name AS third_name)
)
ORDER BY via_name;

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgd_json_graph
  VERTEX TABLES (
    pgd_j_person AS people KEY (person_id)
      LABEL person PROPERTIES (person_id,
        JSON_VALUE(data, '$.name' RETURNING VARCHAR2(50)) AS name,
        JSON_VALUE(data, '$.city' RETURNING VARCHAR2(50)) AS city)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    pgd_j_knows AS links KEY (edge_id)
      SOURCE KEY (src_id) REFERENCES people (person_id)
      DESTINATION KEY (dst_id) REFERENCES people (person_id)
      LABEL knows PROPERTIES (edge_id, JSON_VALUE(data, '$.since' RETURNING NUMBER) AS
        since_year)
  )
  OPTIONS (TRUSTED MODE);

SELECT start_name, via_name, target_name
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (pgd_json_graph
  MATCH (a IS person)-[e1 IS knows]->(b IS person)
                     -[e2 IS knows]->(c IS person)
  WHERE a.person_id = 1
  COLUMNS (a.name AS start_name, b.name AS via_name,
           c.name AS target_name)
)
ORDER BY via_name, target_name;

SELECT person_id, JSON_SERIALIZE(data RETURNING CLOB PRETTY) AS document
FROM pgd_j_person WHERE person_id = 4;
ROLLBACK;

CREATE VIEW pgd_dv_person_v AS
SELECT j.person_id, j.person_name, j.city
FROM pgd_people_dv d,
     JSON_TABLE(d.data, '$' ERROR ON ERROR
       COLUMNS (
         person_id NUMBER PATH '$._id',
         person_name VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.name',
         city VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.city'
       )) j;

CREATE VIEW pgd_dv_knows_v AS
SELECT JSON_VALUE(d.data, '$._id' RETURNING NUMBER ERROR ON ERROR) AS src_id,
       j.edge_id, j.dst_id, j.since_year
FROM pgd_people_dv d,
     JSON_TABLE(d.data, '$.outgoing[*]' ERROR ON ERROR
       COLUMNS (
         edge_id NUMBER PATH '$.edge_id',
         dst_id NUMBER PATH '$.to',
         since_year NUMBER PATH '$.since'
       )) j;

SELECT * FROM pgd_dv_person_v ORDER BY person_id;
SELECT * FROM pgd_dv_knows_v ORDER BY edge_id;

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgd_dv_graph
  VERTEX TABLES (
    pgd_dv_person_v AS people KEY (person_id)
      LABEL person PROPERTIES (person_id, person_name AS name, city)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    pgd_dv_knows_v AS links KEY (edge_id)
      SOURCE KEY (src_id) REFERENCES people (person_id)
      DESTINATION KEY (dst_id) REFERENCES people (person_id)
      LABEL knows PROPERTIES (edge_id, since_year)
  )
  OPTIONS (TRUSTED MODE);

SELECT start_name, via_name, target_name
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (pgd_dv_graph
  MATCH (a IS person)-[e1 IS knows]->(b IS person)
                     -[e2 IS knows]->(c IS person)
  WHERE a.person_id = 1
  COLUMNS (a.name AS start_name, b.name AS via_name,
           c.name AS target_name)
)
ORDER BY via_name, target_name;
ROLLBACK;

SELECT person_id, person_name, ROUND(score, 6) AS pagerank_score
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.PAGERANK(
    pgd_rel_graph,
    PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT pr_score),
    1000, 1e-10, 0.85d, TRUE
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.person_id AS person_id, p.name AS person_name,
           p.pr_score AS score)
)
ORDER BY score DESC, person_id;

SELECT DISTINCT target_name, ROUND(score, 6) AS pagerank_score
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.PAGERANK(
    pgd_rel_graph, PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT pr_score),
    1000, 1e-10, 0.85d, TRUE
  )
  MATCH (a IS person)-[e1 IS knows]->(b IS person)
                     -[e2 IS knows]->(c IS person)
  WHERE a.person_id = 1
  COLUMNS (c.name AS target_name, c.pr_score AS score)
)
ORDER BY pagerank_score DESC, target_name;

SELECT person_id, JSON_SERIALIZE(vertex_identifier RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000)) AS
  vertex_identifier
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (pgd_rel_graph
  MATCH (p IS person)
  WHERE p.person_id IN (1, 3)
  COLUMNS (p.person_id AS person_id, VERTEX_ID(p) AS vertex_identifier)
)
ORDER BY person_id;

SELECT person_id, person_name, ROUND(score, 6) AS alice_score
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.PERSONALIZED_PAGERANK(
    pgd_rel_graph,
    PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT ppr_score),
    JSON_OBJECT(
      'GRAPH_OWNER' VALUE SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SESSION_USER'),
      'GRAPH_NAME' VALUE 'PGD_REL_GRAPH',
      'ELEM_TABLE' VALUE 'PEOPLE',
      'KEY_VALUE' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('PERSON_ID' VALUE 1)
      RETURNING JSON
    ),
    1000, 1e-10, 0.85d, TRUE
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.person_id AS person_id, p.name AS person_name,
           p.ppr_score AS score)
)
ORDER BY score DESC, person_id;

SELECT person_id, person_name, ROUND(score, 6) AS seed_set_score
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.PERSONALIZED_PAGERANK_SET(
    pgd_rel_graph,
    PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT set_score),
    JSON_ARRAY(
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'GRAPH_OWNER' VALUE SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SESSION_USER'),
        'GRAPH_NAME' VALUE 'PGD_REL_GRAPH',
        'ELEM_TABLE' VALUE 'PEOPLE',
        'KEY_VALUE' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('PERSON_ID' VALUE 1)
        RETURNING JSON
      ),
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'GRAPH_OWNER' VALUE SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SESSION_USER'),
        'GRAPH_NAME' VALUE 'PGD_REL_GRAPH',
        'ELEM_TABLE' VALUE 'PEOPLE',
        'KEY_VALUE' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('PERSON_ID' VALUE 3)
        RETURNING JSON
      )
      RETURNING JSON
    ),
    1000, 1e-10, 0.85d, TRUE
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.person_id AS person_id, p.name AS person_name,
           p.set_score AS score)
)
ORDER BY score DESC, person_id;

SELECT component_id, COUNT(*) AS people_count,
       LISTAGG(person_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY person_name) AS members
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.WCC(
    pgd_rel_graph, PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT component_id)
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.name AS person_name, p.component_id AS component_id)
)
GROUP BY component_id
ORDER BY people_count DESC, members;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROPERTY GRAPH pgd_cost_graph
  VERTEX TABLES (
    pgd_person AS people KEY (person_id)
      LABEL person PROPERTIES (person_id, person_name AS name, city)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    pgd_knows AS links KEY (edge_id)
      SOURCE KEY (src_id) REFERENCES people (person_id)
      DESTINATION KEY (dst_id) REFERENCES people (person_id)
      LABEL knows PROPERTIES (
        edge_id, since_year,
        1 AS hop_cost,
        CASE edge_id
          WHEN 101 THEN 1 WHEN 102 THEN 9 WHEN 103 THEN 2
          WHEN 104 THEN 1 WHEN 105 THEN 1 WHEN 106 THEN 1
          WHEN 107 THEN 1 ELSE 1
        END AS effort
      )
  )
  OPTIONS (ENFORCED MODE);

SELECT person_id, person_name, min_hops
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.BELLMAN_FORD(
    pgd_cost_graph,
    JSON_OBJECT(
      'GRAPH_OWNER' VALUE SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SESSION_USER'),
      'GRAPH_NAME' VALUE 'PGD_COST_GRAPH',
      'ELEM_TABLE' VALUE 'PEOPLE',
      'KEY_VALUE' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('PERSON_ID' VALUE 1)
      RETURNING JSON
    ),
    PROPERTY(EDGE INPUT hop_cost DEFAULT ON NULL 1),
    PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT min_hops)
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.person_id AS person_id, p.name AS person_name,
           p.min_hops AS min_hops)
)
ORDER BY person_id;

SELECT person_id, person_name, min_effort
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.BELLMAN_FORD(
    pgd_cost_graph,
    JSON_OBJECT(
      'GRAPH_OWNER' VALUE SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SESSION_USER'),
      'GRAPH_NAME' VALUE 'PGD_COST_GRAPH',
      'ELEM_TABLE' VALUE 'PEOPLE',
      'KEY_VALUE' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('PERSON_ID' VALUE 1)
      RETURNING JSON
    ),
    PROPERTY(EDGE INPUT effort DEFAULT ON NULL 1),
    PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT min_effort)
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.person_id AS person_id, p.name AS person_name,
           p.min_effort AS min_effort)
)
ORDER BY person_id;

SELECT person_id, person_name, ROUND(score, 6) AS pagerank_score
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.PAGERANK(
    pgd_json_graph,
    PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT pr_score),
    1000, 1e-10, 0.85d, TRUE
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.person_id AS person_id, p.name AS person_name,
           p.pr_score AS score)
)
ORDER BY score DESC, person_id;

SELECT component_id, COUNT(*) AS people_count,
       LISTAGG(person_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY person_name) AS members
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.WCC(
    pgd_json_graph, PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT component_id)
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.name AS person_name, p.component_id AS component_id)
)
GROUP BY component_id
ORDER BY people_count DESC, members;
SELECT 'ALGORITHM DEMO COMPLETED' AS status FROM dual;

SELECT person_id, person_name, ROUND(score, 6) AS pagerank_score
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.PAGERANK(
    pgd_dv_graph,
    PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT pr_score),
    1000, 1e-10, 0.85d, TRUE
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.person_id AS person_id, p.name AS person_name,
           p.pr_score AS score)
)
ORDER BY score DESC, person_id;

SELECT component_id, COUNT(*) AS people_count,
       LISTAGG(person_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY person_name) AS members
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  DBMS_OGA.WCC(
    pgd_dv_graph, PROPERTY(VERTEX OUTPUT component_id)
  )
  MATCH (p IS person)
  COLUMNS (p.name AS person_name, p.component_id AS component_id)
)
GROUP BY component_id
ORDER BY people_count DESC, members;
GRANT READ ON PROPERTY GRAPH pgd_rel_graph TO PG_READER;

SELECT name
FROM system_privilege_map
WHERE name LIKE '%PROPERTY GRAPH'
ORDER BY name;
